title: TopicNode
description: A node of the content taxonomy (category, subcategory or leaf). One file per node: content/topics/<id>.yaml (TS-02.1.1).

ref.description: Taxonomy number for humans (e.g. 3.2.1.2). May change when the tree is reorganised; never used in URLs.
ref.x-format-name: a dotted taxonomy number such as 3.2.1.2

formerSlugs.description: Previous slugs of this node; each gets a static redirect page (TS-02.1.3).

parent.description: Parent node id, or null for a root category.

synonyms.description: Alternative names and abbreviations indexed by search (ADR 0004).

status.description: Editorial status shown on the content status page (TS-03.0.2).

lastReviewed.description: Date of the last SME review (YYYY-MM-DD); shown on the page (TS-04.5.2).

seeAlso.description: Cross-links (→ in the taxonomy): ids of nodes whose content is also relevant here.

blocks.description: Content blocks of a leaf node, in display order. Only leaves have blocks; nodes without published blocks are hidden.
